payout_quote: Open a new free checking account today and receive a $250 bonus. Use Code CHECKING250 to claim your reward. Receive a $250 reward when you open a new primary free checking account and perform the following actions within the first 90 days after account opening: sign up for eStatements, make monthly deposits totaling $500 or more per month for three consecutive months, and conduct 10 or more qualifying debit card transactions per month for three consecutive months.
steps: Open a new primary free checking account online or in person, presenting promo code CHECKING250 at account opening.
Make monthly deposits totaling $500 or more per month for three consecutive months.
Conduct 10 or more qualifying debit card purchases per month for three consecutive months.
catches: Offer EXPIRES September 30, 2026 (8 days from check date) - account must be opened by then.
New primary checking accounts only; one $250 offer per individual; must be 18+.
Requires BOTH $500+/month deposits AND 10+ debit card purchases per month for three consecutive months - sustained activity, not a one-time setup.
ATM withdrawals/deposits and payment-service transfers (Venmo, CashApp, Zelle) do not count as qualifying debit transactions.
$250 reward deposited within 60 days of meeting qualification criteria - payout takes months.

The $250 bonus is generally treated as taxable interest income (typically reported on Form 1099-INT); consult a tax advisor - this is general bank-bonus tax treatment, not a statement from the credit union's terms.
Texas-based credit union (1600+ ATMs in Texas); membership eligibility applies.
Terms subject to change without notice.
